notes: Keral Keep Disciples, printed: 'Whenever YOU activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.' On the opponent's turn THEY activate their Chandra, Flame's Catalyst's +1 (3 damage to each of their opponents): your Disciples do not trigger, you 20 -> 17, opponent stays 20. On your turn you activate your own Chandra, Flame's Catalyst's +1: 3 from Chandra plus 1 from the Disciples, opponent 20 -> 16. You never take Disciples damage.
